_comment: Copy to identities.local.json and fill in the values from YOUR captures.
identities.local.json is git-ignored and must never be committed: it is
a plaintext list of your own identifiers.
The anonymiser replaces every occurrence of each key with its value,
including inside base64-wrapped JSON. Keep the SHAPE of the replacement
the same as the original (a 12-hex MAC stays 12 hex) so that any length
check or parser in a decoder still sees a well-formed value.
Longest keys are substituted first, so a short id nested inside a longer
composite (a device id inside 'run.<id>.huami.com') is not half-replaced.
_integers_comment: Zepp sends the same identifier as a string in one endpoint and a bare
integer in another (a band row's `source`, the sleep block's
sleepSource / napSleepSource). String replacement cannot see those, so
list them here as numbers too.
